grammarEvidence.explanation: stmt_if consumes expr_until_then; that calls read_sql_expression(K_THEN). read_sql_construct terminates at K_THEN with parenthesis depth zero and counts only parentheses/brackets, not CASE nesting. The earlier CASE THEN therefore ends an incomplete IF SQL expression.
